event.summary: Inherited FARHELM_TMUX does not leak into session children
event.detail:
Reviewed commit: 17a3fe858c5511a24b7403af15dd41c93bf69fd7
TLDR: Considered whether removing desktop tmux configuration while retaining ambient inheritance could send a stale tmux setting into new sessions. Source refutes this consequence.
Details: The desktop spawn at desktop.rs:1175–1200 removes app-only variables but no longer sets or removes FARHELM_TMUX. A git grep at the reviewed revision found no UI use and only the supervisor child-environment scrub as a runtime occurrence of FARHELM_TMUX in the inspected runtime trees. service/core/host_launch.rs:108–115 includes FARHELM_TMUX in NOT_INHERITED, and host_child_env at :141–147 removes it after merging both supervisor environment and launch overrides. SPEC_impl.md, Terminal substrate: private tmux server, says exactly: `Nothing this release starts or renders sets it, but a supervisor unit an earlier release wrote keeps setting it until its next setup or Update; the supervisor ignores it.`
Suggested bucket: other (refuted consequence). Confidence: confirmed by source, not runtime execution. proposed_drop: source refutation; child assembly removes the variable even if ambient supervisor inheritance retains it. Could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work route; the considered consequence was obsolete session configuration only. possible_cover: none; coverage sources not searched. Caveat: this is a removal-impact check, not an independent review of the entire child-environment implementation.

event.summary: Removing the tmux preflight leaves no runtime tmux dependency
event.detail:
Reviewed commit: 17a3fe858c5511a24b7403af15dd41c93bf69fd7
TLDR: Considered whether the app could now fail to start, or launch sessions against an unsupported tmux, because its missing/below-floor tmux checks and prefix search were deleted. The replacement uses Farhelm's own terminal-host program, so these deletions remove checks for a dependency no longer used.
Details: desktop.rs:440–550 still discovers or starts the supervisor and waits until it answers; :1149–1157 preserves the session-program-path prerequisite before :533 stops an owned predecessor. service/core.rs:6116–6184 opens the store and ends/reloads old terminals without resolving tmux. service/core/old_terminals.rs:176–202 connects directly to the old server's Unix socket, and :223–231 signals its pinned process; it does not execute a tmux binary. New terminal hosts are selected from the supervisor's own executable by service/core/host_launch.rs:388–390. tmux.rs:1–11 describes the remaining module as the provisioning version parser. Full-revision grep for tmux_probe, tmux_preflight, find_tmux_in_prefixes, run_tmux_preflight_or_exit and resolve_supervisor_tmux across crates, scripts, .github and e2e returned no occurrences, so the deleted modules have no dangling references there. SPEC_impl.md:2786–2791 states: `Neither the desktop app nor farhelm helm setup requires, looks for or names a tmux, and neither does the installer.` (Inline code formatting omitted in this quotation.)
Suggested bucket: other (refuted removal regression). Confidence: confirmed by source, not observed execution. proposed_drop: source refutation; the deleted executable search and bounded version probe have no runtime consumer at this revision. Could-be-highest: the historical purpose included preventing unsupported tmux crashes that could lose sessions, but no shipped path was found that executes a selected tmux for sessions after this change; there is no established highest route. This conclusion rests on removal of that runtime path, not only on a specification acceptance. possible_cover: none; coverage sources not searched. Caveats: no runtime startup or builds run; this is not an independent review of old-terminal cleanup or provisioning.
